svg.title: Tinker — repair robot
svg.desc: A seafoam repair robot with a magnifier visor flipped down over its eyes from a headband with hinge knobs at the temples, a tall rolling tool chest body with a lid and five drawers with slate handles, four caster wheels, and tool arms ending in a screwdriver and needle nose pliers.
